notes: Modified cash basis city (business-type activities on accrual basis), handled like FY2023. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis, Total Governmental Funds column (p5); Bond proceeds 845,000 and Loan proceeds 58,853 are printed among revenues, so they are receipt lines. Intergovernmental 283,370 split by the printed Street Fund budget lines (p15) and General Fund State assistance (p20); Grants and contributions 586,680 split into CDBG Grant income 371,911 (p18) and the remaining 214,769 (General 174,269 + Street 40,000 + Sales Tax 500). Total column prints net Transfers in (out) 1,158,487 (in), matching the Light Fund's transfers to other funds. Beginning cash not printed; ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash lines (p4); fund balances 2,721,006 -> 3,395,476 (roll-forward ties). Internal service fund (governmental activities) excluded from governmental lines. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position, Total enterprise column (pp8-9), measure net position 8,072,226 -> 7,067,450 (ties); proprietary null as in FY2023. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1) by Governmental / Business-type column; component unit excluded. Detail: General Fund from the departments combining statement (pp20-21; the General Fund budget schedule p14 is not recorded to avoid double counting); Street, Sales Tax, LB840 and CDBG budget schedules (pp15-18, zero-actual lines omitted); nonmajor Keno, Nolde Trust and Cemetery Perpetual Care funds from the combining statement (p19); utility funds (Light, Water, Sewer, Trash) from the proprietary statement fund columns (pp8-9) since no utility schedules are printed. The Debt Service Fund budget schedule is not in the trim, so the Debt Service Fund has no detail lines. Read pages 1-21 of 21
